raw_response:
This plot is only a small quarter-timad near my house, so one full bag of fertilizer from the cooperative is too costly and too much for this little piece — I need my cash for the bigger fields. I will spread cow manure from my homestead here instead, and plant seed I kept from last season because I know it grows well. My daughter and I can do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves in about ten days; there is no reason to hire anyone for such a small plot.
